reasoning: A shield with a plus badge clearly signifies adding security protection, enrolling in an insurance policy, or health coverage. It fits a common set of personal admin, finance, and tech tasks, though the plus badge can occasionally blur with a medical cross or be confused with other badged shields (like shield-check) at tiny sizes.
